text:
maria: Quick preflight check for SOC2 fieldwork next week — need final owners for three things: keystore/KMS smoke in staging, auditlog ingestion sampling/backfill, and HSM attestation slot verification. Any blockers? @alex @jon @priya

alex: I can own the keystore/KMS smoke. Plan to run staging smoke tomorrow at 11:00 PT. Need firewall rule to allow auditors' IPs into keystore-staging. @devops can you confirm what you need?

devops: Can do. Need a ticket with the CIDR(s) and the maintenance window. Note: we only open firewall in the scheduled maintenance window (10:00-12:00 PT). Also ping if we need SSH bastion access.

jon: I own auditlog ingest. There's a schema mismatch in the backfill path — fix is in PR #482, awaiting review. If we can get that merged today we can run a small backfill sample before fieldwork. @priya can you review?

priya: Will review PR #482 by 15:00 PT. Also need a sample export of the keystore audit events (no PII) for the auditors to validate mapping. @security-bot can you produce a sample?

security-bot: Generated sample: keystore-audit-sample-2026-03-17.csv (sanitized) uploaded to s3://redwood-internal/tmp/keystore-audit-sample-2026-03-17.csv. Retention TTL 48h.

sam-sre: Quick FYI — HSM attestation scheduler has a race when nodes drain; I have a small patch that retries the attestation flight when drain=true. Prefer to canary the fix after the keystore smoke so we don't introduce risk during auditors' window.

maria: Okay action items: Alex -> open ticket with CIDR and requested window; Jon -> get PR merged or post blocker; Priya -> review by 3pm and confirm sample is sufficient; Sam -> prepare canary for HSM patch and hold until post-smoke. I'll summarize and notify SOC2 ops. :white_check_mark:

alex: Ticket created: INC-1284 with CIDR 203.0.113.0/24 and requested window 2026-03-18 10:00-11:30 PT. Added note for bastion if auditors need shell access.

devops: Approved. Firewall change scheduled for 2026-03-18 10:00-11:30 PT. Bastion jumpbox can be enabled as an exception; request separate PKI clause and SSH user list.

maria: Thanks all. If anyone can't make the window or hits a blocker, call it out here — otherwise we'll proceed with smoke + canary plan.

alex: Quick smoke command I'll run in staging if helpful:
```
kubectl -n keystore-staging exec -it smoke-check -- /bin/sh -c "curl -fsS https://keystore.internal/healthz | grep ok"
```

priya: PR reviewed & approved. Jon, merge when ready and I can kick off a small backfill sample.

jon: Merged PR #482 at 14:32 PT. Scheduling a 10k-event sample backfill at 16:00 PT; will post results here.

sam-sre: Canary prepared; will hold deploy until confirmation that smoke passed. Plan: canary -> 5% -> monitor 30m -> roll.

maria: Great. I'll update the SOC2 checklist and add these owners under the preflight row. Thanks everyone. :v:
